entities.summary: Eusebio Ramos Morales is a Puerto Rican born American prelate of the Roman Catholic Church. He has been serving as bishop for the Diocese of Caguas in Puerto Rico since 2017. He previously served as bishop of the Diocese of Fajardo-Humacao in Puerto Rico from 2008 to 2017
